mainEntity.name: What kind of bathroom floor will hold up best over time?

acceptedAnswer.text: For bathrooms, the best long-term result is a floor that stays **water-resistant, level, and easy to clean**. Tile usually offers the longest wear, while waterproof vinyl can give a warmer feel and quicker install. The final outcome depends on the material, the quality of prep, and how well the edges and transitions are sealed.
acceptedAnswer.description: A properly installed moisture-resistant floor will last much longer than a rushed one. Tile is typically the most durable, while waterproof vinyl is a popular easier-maintenance option.
